view_title: แปลนคานโครงหลังคารอบล่าง
views: view1: แปลนคานโครงหลังคารอบล่าง 1:75 — คาน BX + กันสาดหลังคารอบล่าง R (โครงเหล็ก จันทัน/แป/TILE ROD) — roof_frame_plan (this file)
warnings: Lower roof (หลังคารอบล่าง) framing: RC beams BX on every perimeter column line (rows A, E and grids 1, 5) at the column heads, and a steel canopy R projecting 2.00 on the grid-1, grid-5 and row-E sides (none on the row-A front, where the RC canopy of S-02 is).

Inside canopy R the heavy lines on the column lines carry the leaders 'TILE ROD ø-12 mm.' and 'Tension Turnbuckle' (the sloping slings of the sections: 'สลิงเหล็กชุบสังกะสี ขนาด Ø 12 มม.'); the thin lines between them, drawn at about 0.50, carry 'จันทันเหล็ก ⊠125x50x3.0 มม.'. The rod segments are recorded per column line; the rafters are not dimensioned and are recorded once per side as an area, with no invented spacing or count.

Purlins: three lines parallel to the wall with three different sizes (⊠100x50x2.3 nearest the wall, ⊠50x50x2.3 in the middle, ⊠125x50x2.3 at the outer edge) — positions of the inner two are not dimensioned; recorded as area entries with flags.
'⊠' (box) sizes are written as hollow sections: designation RHS, d x b x t (section 6a).
